title: custom decimal separator with $ characters is mangled
prompt: With the decimal option, humanize-duration.js mangles separators that contain a dollar sign: humanizer()(1250, { decimal: '$$' }) gives '1$25 seconds' instead of '1$$25 seconds'. Other dollar sequences such as '$&', "$`" and "$'" are also expanded wrongly instead of being used literally. Please make any custom decimal string appear exactly as given.
